options.text: Binary-searches history to find the commit that introduced a bug
Merges two branches at their midpoint

questions.explanation: git bisect does a binary search between a known-good and a known-bad commit, halving the range each step to pinpoint the first bad commit.

options.text: The person responsible for every bug
For each line, the commit, author, and date that last modified it

questions.explanation: git blame annotates each line with the commit/author/date that last changed it — useful context, though the last change may just be a reformat, not the logic's author.

questions.prompt: Which statements are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: bisect uses good/bad marks to narrow the search
git bisect run can automate the search with a test script
git log -S finds commits that added or removed a given string
git blame reliably identifies who is at fault for a bug

questions.explanation: bisect narrows via good/bad, bisect run automates it, and log -S (the pickaxe) finds where a string changed. blame shows the last change, not fault for logic.

questions.prompt: To let Git automatically run your test at each bisect step, use: git bisect ___ ./test.sh
questions.explanation: git bisect run <script> drives the whole search automatically, using the script's exit code (0 = good, non-zero = bad).

questions.prompt: You have ~500 commits between a known-good release and a broken HEAD, plus a script that detects the bug. What's the fastest way to find the culprit commit?

options.text: Read every commit diff by hand
git bisect (ideally with bisect run), which finds it in about log2(500) ≈ 9 steps
Revert commits one by one from HEAD

questions.explanation: Binary search checks a midpoint each step, so ~500 commits take only about 9 tests. bisect run automates it with your script.

questions.prompt: Match each tool to its purpose.

pairs.right: Show the last change per line
Find when a string was added/removed

questions.explanation: bisect locates the bad commit, blame annotates lines, log -S traces a string's history, and bisect run automates the search.
